verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer gc-decomp-harness reference, this board provides similarly strong regional grouping and semantic color but lacks its routing restraint, clear label air, and polished visual hierarchy.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The four upper workflow regions and full-width reliability band use most of the frame, though the broad routing gap between the upper system and lower band feels under-composed.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Many nodes have comfortable internal padding, but the coordination and fulfillment areas are crowded by closely spaced wires, arrowheads, and labels such as the warehouse and carrier annotations.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Distinct blue, cyan, violet, green, and peach tinted regions clearly separate intake, backbone, coordination, fulfillment, and reliability concerns.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Color is mostly semantic and consistent—green success, red cancellation, magenta compensation, and family-specific flows—although the number of simultaneous hues becomes visually noisy in the center.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Failure: several connectors terminate or turn at conspicuous routing points, dashed paths merge ambiguously around the coordinator, and the narrow floating terminal-order-rule badge reads as an unanchored artifact.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The major section boundaries and lower-row cards hold useful registers, but uneven node sizing, raw Markdown-like text, and the compressed center-right cluster interrupt the rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Failure: long orange, blue, teal, and magenta perimeter runs dominate the lower half, while overlapping and tightly parallel routes around the coordinator make several branch destinations difficult to trace.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The visual ordering and assigned scores agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first at 7.5, intent-classification-2 second at 7.0, and the board under grade third at 6.5.
